metas.name: Wild Kratts
metas.description: Similar to 'The Magic School Bus' and 'Ada Twist, Scientist', this show combines adventure with real-world animal facts and conservation.

metas.name: Octonauts
metas.description: Like 'Doc McStuffins' and 'Curious George', it features a team solving problems, but in an underwater setting with fascinating marine life.

metas.name: Sid the Science Kid
metas.description: A great follow-up to 'Ada Twist, Scientist' and 'Numberblocks', focusing on early childhood science exploration and inquiry.

metas.name: Ask the StoryBots
metas.description: An animated musical series that answers kids' questions about the world, akin to the educational curiosity of 'Peg + Cat' and 'Numberblocks'.

metas.name: Daniel Tiger's Neighborhood
metas.description: A gentle and educational show that teaches social-emotional skills, similar to the helpfulness seen in 'Special Agent Oso' and the kindness of 'Clifford the Big Red Dog'.

metas.name: Paw Patrol
metas.description: Features a team of pups working together to solve problems, similar to the teamwork in 'Special Agent Oso' and the adventurous spirit of 'WordGirl'.

metas.name: Tumble Leaf
metas.description: A beautifully animated show that encourages exploration and imaginative play, mirroring the gentle curiosity of 'Curious George' and the discovery in 'Bluey'.

metas.name: Sarah & Duck
metas.description: A charming and whimsical show about friendship and everyday adventures, with a gentle pace similar to 'Bluey' and 'Curious George'.

metas.name: Super Why!
metas.description: Focuses on early literacy skills and problem-solving through fairy tales, much like 'WordGirl' uses language for good.

metas.name: Ready Jet Go!
metas.description: Introduces kids to space and science through the adventures of a boy who moves to Earth from the planet Bortron 7. Great for fans of 'The Magic School Bus'.

metas.name: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!
metas.description: Educational and fun, this show explores scientific concepts through whimsical adventures, much like 'Ada Twist, Scientist'.

metas.name: Arthur
metas.description: A classic animated series dealing with relatable childhood issues and social dynamics, similar to the family themes in 'The Simpsons' and the learning in 'Bluey'.

metas.name: Cyberchase
metas.description: Teaches math and problem-solving skills in an engaging way, a good progression from 'Numberblocks' and 'Peg + Cat'.

metas.name: If You Give a Mouse a Cookie
metas.description: Based on the beloved books, this series follows a series of cause-and-effect adventures, encouraging logical thinking like 'Peg + Cat'.

metas.name: Hilda
metas.description: A beautifully animated series with a sense of wonder and adventure, featuring magical creatures and strong friendships, appealing to fans of 'Bluey' and 'The Magic School Bus'.

metas.name: Molly of Denali
metas.description: An interactive show that incorporates reading and critical thinking skills, following the adventures of an Alaskan Native girl. Similar to 'WordGirl' in its educational focus.

metas.name: Esme & Roy
metas.description: Focuses on problem-solving and imaginative play through the eyes of two young monster sitters. Good for those who enjoy 'Bluey' and 'Doc McStuffins'.

metas.name: Go Jetters
metas.description: An animated series that teaches geography and landmarks around the world, similar to the educational expeditions in 'The Magic School Bus'.

metas.name: Stretch Armstrong & the Flex Fighters
metas.description: While animated and action-oriented like 'WordGirl', this offers a slightly older demographic superhero adventure with themes of friendship and responsibility.

metas.name: Trash Truck
metas.description: A gentle and charming series about friendship and the simple joys of exploration, resonating with the feel of 'Bluey' and 'Curious George'.

metas.name: Puffin Rock
metas.description: A beautifully animated show about nature and siblings, perfect for younger children who enjoy shows like 'Clifford the Big Red Dog' and 'Octonauts'.

metas.name: The Mr. Peabody & Sherman Show
metas.description: Educational and humorous, this series takes viewers on historical adventures, similar to the educational scope of 'The Magic School Bus'.

metas.name: True and the Rainbow Kingdom
metas.description: Features a brave heroine who helps citizens of the Rainbow Kingdom solve problems with her magic wishes, encouraging creative thinking like 'Peg + Cat'.

metas.name: Alma's Way
metas.description: Aimed at preschoolers, this show centers on a young Puerto Rican girl and her family, focusing on community and problem-solving. Similar to 'Doc McStuffins' in its focus on everyday life.

metas.name: Xavier Riddle and the Secret Museum
metas.description: An educational series where characters travel through time to meet historical figures, similar to the educational exploration of 'The Magic School Bus'.

metas.name: T.U.F.F. Puppy
metas.description: A lighthearted action-comedy with a dog protagonist, offering silly humor and problem-solving that may appeal to fans of 'WordGirl' and 'Special Agent Oso'.

metas.name: The Loud House
metas.description: A family sitcom with a large cast of siblings, offering humor and relatable family dynamics, similar to 'The Simpsons' but for a younger audience.

metas.name: Olaf Presents
metas.description: A short series where Olaf retells Disney movies with his own comedic twist, perfect for fans of animated comedy like 'Bluey'.

metas.name: The Snoopy Show
metas.description: Charming animated shorts featuring Snoopy and Woodstock, focusing on friendship and simple adventures, reminiscent of the lighthearted feel of 'Curious George'.

metas.name: Pete the Cat
metas.description: An animated series based on the popular books, focusing on embracing new experiences and friendship, similar to 'Clifford the Big Red Dog'.

metas.name: Ricky Zoom
metas.description: Follows a young boy who lives in a family of rescue bikers, focusing on friendship, teamwork, and community service, similar to 'Paw Patrol'.

metas.name: Bunk'd
metas.description: A live-action family sitcom about siblings at a summer camp, offering lighthearted humor and friendship stories. A good option for fans of family sitcoms.

metas.name: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse
metas.description: An interactive educational series for preschoolers featuring classic Disney characters, focusing on problem-solving and early math concepts. Similar to 'Numberblocks' and 'Peg + Cat'.

metas.name: Sofia the First
metas.description: A princess who learns to rule with kindness and wisdom, often involving problem-solving and learning lessons. Similar themes to 'Doc McStuffins'.

metas.name: Inspector Gadget
metas.description: A classic animated series about a bumbling detective and his adventures, with humor and problem-solving that can appeal to kids who enjoy 'WordGirl'.

metas.name: Pinky Malinky
metas.description: A humorous animated series about a hot dog who navigates the human world, offering quirky comedy and relatable situations for kids who enjoy 'Bluey'.

metas.name: Lost in Oz
metas.description: A modern animated take on the Wizard of Oz, with adventure and a strong female lead. Similar to the fantasy elements in 'The Magic School Bus'.

metas.name: The Last Kids on Earth
metas.description: This animated series follows a group of kids surviving a monster apocalypse, focusing on teamwork and humor. It's a good fit for those who liked the action in 'WordGirl'.

metas.name: Chip 'n' Dale: Park Life
metas.description: A series of charming shorts featuring Chip and Dale's misadventures, offering lighthearted humor and visual gags, similar to the playful nature of 'Curious George'.
